title: THREE DAYS STATE LEVEL FDP ON UNLOCKING GENERATIVE AI
content:
REPORT on THREE DAYS STATE LEVEL FDP ON UNLOCKING GENERATIVE AI

Organized by

Organized by Department of CSE-Data Science

The Department of Computer Science & Engineering (Data Science) at ATME College of Engineering successfully organized a Three-Day State-Level Faculty Development Program (FDP) on "Unlocking Generative AI" from February 10th to 12th, 2025. The program aimed to provide a foundation in Natural Language Processing (NLP), Prompt Engineering, and Hands-on Training aligned with the VTU syllabus for the 6th Semester subject "Generative AI – BAIL657C". The event was held in association with IEI, ATME IEEE Student branch-35744, IQAC- ATMECE. 

The FDP was inaugurated by Dr. L. Basavaraj, Principal, ATMECE, in the presence of distinguished guests, faculty members, and participants from various institutions. The welcome speech was delivered by Dr. Anitha D B, Associate Professor & Head, CSE-Data Science, highlighting the growing importance of Generative AI in academia and industry. She emphasized how NLP and AI-driven models like GPT, BERT, and LangChain are revolutionizing modern technology.
